projects.title: TheSwapp
projects.description: A multi-tenant church ministry platform live on AWS. Owned the complete Angular 13 frontend and contributed to backend REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js.
features: Owned the complete Angular 13 frontend with role-based dashboards, tenant-isolated views, reusable Bootstrap components, route guards, and lazy-loaded modules.
Contributed to backend development using Node.js and Express.js for REST APIs, MongoDB/Mongoose models, JWT-secured endpoints, and Joi validation.
Applied Helmet-based security hardening across backend routes.
Integrated Stripe, Google Maps, Twilio, and Nodemailer for payments, location services, and member communication.
projects.note: Church ministry platform — multi-tenant, live on AWS (December 2025).

projects.title: CQ Servicing
projects.description: A multi-tenant lending platform serving 18 institutions with configurable workflows, tenant-isolated views, reporting screens, and approval workflows.
features: Built frontend modules with dashboards, configurable workflows, tenant-isolated views, reporting screens, and approval workflows.
Implemented loan lifecycle screens, document handling, PDF generation, and Excel exports.
Delivered analytics dashboards and calendar workflows across the loan lifecycle.
Improved loan processing efficiency by 40% through streamlined product flow design.

projects.title: WellCare Health
projects.description: A healthcare platform with patient, provider, and admin workflows — responsive screens, role-based access, and REST API integrations.
features: Led frontend delivery for patient, provider, and admin workflows with responsive screens and reusable UI patterns.
Implemented role-based access, route guards, form validation, and REST API integrations.
Built RxJS data flows, Firebase Storage uploads, and Chart.js dashboards.
Reduced initial load time by 35% with lazy-loaded modules, OnPush change detection, and route-level code splitting.

experience.title: Frontend Engineer
experience.description: Frontend Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications using React.js, Angular, and TypeScript across enterprise products.
bullets: Developed 10+ production web applications in React.js and Angular with TypeScript, REST API integration, token-based authentication, HTTP interceptors, and cross-browser support.
Built reusable, responsive, WCAG 2.1 AA accessible UI component libraries with designers and backend engineers, reducing repeated frontend effort by 30%.
Optimized Core Web Vitals and reduced redundant API calls by 20–30% using code splitting, lazy loading, tree shaking, and RxJS caching with shareReplay and TTL.
Implemented Redux, NgRx, and RxJS state management to deliver predictable data flows across dashboards and product workflows.
Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and backend engineers while writing unit tests with Jest, Karma, and Jasmine targeting 80%+ coverage on critical modules.

experience.title: Angular (2025 Edition)
experience.description: Deep refresh on modern Angular — components, RxJS, routing, forms, state, and performance patterns aligned with current production stacks.
bullets: Reinforced Angular fundamentals through hands-on modules covering components, services, and dependency injection.
Practiced RxJS-based data flows, route guards, lazy loading, and OnPush change detection patterns.
Strengthened TypeScript usage, reactive forms, and structured Angular project organization.
